async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the 'Settings' link to go to project settings
    # Use filtering to select the correct 'Settings' link by its exact name and URL
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings", exact=True).filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings", exact=True))
    await settings_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: On settings page, click the 'Members' link
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members")
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Invite Koushik as a guest
    invite_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite members")
    await invite_button.click()
    
    # Fill in Koushik's username
    invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="GitLab username or email address")
    await invite_input.fill("Koushik")
    
    # Select 'Guest' role
    role_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role")
    await role_dropdown.select_option("Guest")
    
    # Submit the invitation
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for action to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Task completed
    return "Invited Koushik as a guest to the dotfiles repo."
